steps.step: re-apply after rollback matches first apply

deviations: RULE-077 and DATAAREAID (asked, answer deferred): docs/answers.md (2026-10-26) says both RULE-077 conditions also match on DATAAREAID. Subs.tblSubsInvoices has no DATAAREAID column, and neither SPEC-001 nor DES-001 mentions one. The only way to get an invoice's legal entity is its own CUSTTRANS_RICS row (Rec_ID = RECID), and matching that way would fail the approved suite: in TC-002-011 to TC-002-018 the invoice Rec_IDs have no CUSTTRANS_RICS row, and DATAAREAID is NULL in the faked table. Assumption built: scope is ACCOUNTNUM + VOUCHER, or ACCOUNTNUM + LASTSETTLEVOUCHER, both against Subs.tblSubsInvoices, with no DATAAREAID match. Adding the legal-entity match needs a spec, design and test change first.

brnz_subs_invoice.fully_credited type (asked, answer deferred): DES-001 makes it nvarchar(1), but the source Fully_Credited is varchar(3), and Subs.usp_Refresh_SubsInvoices writes 'N/A' for every invoice that has no credit. Built to the design. Because source rows are staged in the target's types, the load raises a truncation error (2628/8152), logs 'Failed' and leaves the target unchanged instead of silently cutting 'N/A' to 'N' (unit test pins this). On production data the invoice load will therefore fail until the column is widened (nvarchar(3) suggested).
notes:
Objects: brnz_subs_invoice and brnz_subs_invoice_line (design columns, PK on rec_id / recid, the four bronze audit columns with named defaults), plus usp_load_brnz_subs_invoice and usp_load_brnz_subs_invoice_line. Both loads follow the Phase 1 bronze pattern: optional @run_id, usp_etl_log_start/end, update changed rows (and restore soft-deleted ones that reappear, counted as updates), insert new rows, soft-delete rows that are gone, then a live-vs-source row-count check (RULE-005). The changes run in one transaction, XACT_ABORT is on, and errors are logged 'Failed' and re-thrown. Source rows are first staged into a temp table typed like the target, so overflow or truncation fails the load rather than being silently cast. Change detection compares strings as bytes, so case-only and trailing-space changes are landed. CUSTTRANS_RICS TRANSDATE (datetime) is rounded to datetime2(0) when staged, so reruns stay idempotent. The line scope (RULE-077) is read from Subs.tblSubsInvoices, not from bronze. EXISTS lands a row only once, even when it meets both conditions or matches several invoices. A settling row on another account is not landed (answers.md). Lines whose invoice leaves the source are soft-deleted. A duplicate RECID or Rec_ID in the source fails the load with a PK violation (2627) rather than picking a row. The unit tests (test_MOD002_dev, 8 tests) cover: byte-level updates, restore counts, the Fully_Credited truncation error path, other-account settling rows, a line matching two invoices, millisecond TRANSDATE idempotency, a case-only paymmode update, and the duplicate-RECID error path. No grants are needed.

Test-first: the first run had 19 of 19 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 19 of 19 and 8 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
